Q1: Fluorescein is classified with a known significant oral hazard (Tier 1) and potential dermal and eye hazards (Tier 2). While it shows a demonstrated low to moderate endocrine disruption hazard (Tier 3), it is data deficient (Tier 4) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, environmental, inhalation, and organ/systemic hazards.
Q2: Fluorescein is not identified on any official lists of concern or low hazard. This absence, combined with several data-deficient hazard categories (Tier 4), suggests a lack of comprehensive evaluation rather than confirmed safety.
Q3: Fluorescein appears relatively well-characterized, possessing a defined molecular formula (C20H12O5) and classification as a Small Molecule. With 23,000 scientific references, it is extensively studied compared to many chemicals in the specialized dataset, yet significant data gaps remain across several hazard categories, indicating an incomplete hazard profile.
